source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/'Caros Ledge UI System.dc.html' #sys, the 'Fact card — replaces every "FACT: … *Source: …" paragraph' block; README.md §0.4 'Fact card'; operator ruling 2.4 (2026-09-07, UI discrepancy report)
notes: The expected values below are operator ruling 2.4 (2026-09-07), which is the latest binding statement on this part and states exact numbers: sourced = 2px solid #1A1A1A LEFT edge, 1px rgba(0,0,0,.12) on the other three sides, radius 0 8px 8px 0, white; inference = 1px DASHED rgba(0,0,0,.25) all round, background #FAFAF8, italic body; needs counsel = 2px solid #F97316 left edge, otherwise as sourced.

The artboard 00 markup differs from that ruling and is recorded here so the divergence is visible rather than silently resolved: sourced there is `background:#fff; border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12); border-radius:8px; border-left:3px solid #5A5552; padding:12px 14px 12px 16px`; inference is `background:#F5F2EE; border:1px dashed rgba(0,0,0,.3); border-radius:8px`; counsel is the sourced box with `border-left:3px solid #F97316`. Where the two disagree the operator's ruling is used, per the ruling's own framing ('build against them, ask nothing').
The variants are addressed through the mount's `[data-audit]` wrappers, which carry no styling of their own; `> div` inside each is the FactCard's own root element.

forbid.name: a raw URL in the card's running text
forbid.reason: README §0.4: 'Raw URLs never appear in running text.' The link belongs in the source column, as a labelled anchor.
